name: Firsthand Editorial Team
bio: Firsthand's editorial team fact-checks every money article against the primary sources it cites — bank and issuer official rate/fee schedules, company pricing and security documentation, and regulator publications from the CFPB, FDIC, NCUA, SEC, FINRA, IRS, and the Federal Reserve — before publication. Firsthand does not employ a licensed financial advisor, CFP, CFA, tax professional, or attorney. This is editorial fact-checking, not professional financial, investment, tax, or legal advice.
